intro.en: Dashboard and instrument-cluster harnesses link the cluster, cockpit switches, HVAC controls, display, body controller and junctions specified for a vehicle. We build full cross-car looms, cluster jumpers, center-console branches and repair pigtails. Each version follows an approved pin map, installation route and service boundary—not a universal dashboard plug.
intro.zh: 仪表台与仪表盘线束按具体车型连接组合仪表、座舱开关、空调控制、显示或主机、车身控制器及配电接口。可定制横跨仪表台的总线束、仪表盘短引线、中控分支、开关尾线或受控替换件。每一款都要按车辆变型、针脚表、安装路径和维修边界定义，不能只凭所谓通用仪表插头判断。

knowledge.en: The visible display is only one endpoint of a vehicle electrical architecture. Power, grounds, illumination, CAN or LIN and sometimes other data links may reach the cluster through dedicated connectors; exact circuits vary by platform. A fit-matching shell does not prove correct signals, software configuration, warning telltales or safety function.
knowledge.zh: 可见的显示界面只是整车电气架构的一个端点。电源、接地、照明、CAN 或 LIN，以及其他数据链路可能通过专用接口到达组合仪表；具体回路随平台改变。壳体能对插，不证明信号、软件配置、警示灯或安全功能正确。

notes.en: Send the vehicle/platform and model year, variant or trim, right- or left-hand-drive layout, circuit and cavity tables, mating connector part numbers, cluster and controller references, route drawings or sample, mounting clips, branch datums, expected quantities and agreed inspection points. Identify any SRS or other safety-critical interfaces separately.
notes.zh: 请提供车型平台与年款、配置变型、左右舵布局、回路与孔位表、对插件料号、仪表与控制器资料、走线图或样品、卡扣、分支基准、预计数量和约定检验项；涉及 SRS 等安全关键接口须单独标识。

delivery.en: Approved information becomes a controlled drawing, connector and pin matrix, BOM, branch geometry, labels and inspection plan. First-article review checks mating, reach, terminal seating, clip positions, clearance and circuit identity. Continuity or short testing does not certify the cluster's displayed functions, SRS performance or vehicle-level behavior; those need separate OEM-led validation.
delivery.zh: 批准资料转化为受控图纸、连接器与针脚矩阵、物料表、分支几何、标签和检验计划。首件核对对插、可达、端子入位、卡扣位置、间隙及回路身份。导通或短路测试不代表仪表显示功能、SRS 性能或整车行为已验证；这些需要另行按整车方要求验证。

introduction.en: From the visible cockpit to the hidden circuit map
introduction.zh: 从可见的座舱，读懂背后的回路

subtitle.en: Cluster, switch, HVAC and display branches; connector identity, routing and controlled release
subtitle.zh: 组合仪表、开关、空调与显示分支，以及接口、走线和受控放行

lead.en: An instrument-panel harness is not one cable behind a screen. It is a packaged network of short branches, cross-car routes and service disconnects. Start with the vehicle's actual electrical architecture, then decide which portion the customer needs us to build.
lead.zh: 仪表台线束不是屏幕后面的一根线。它由短分支、横向走线和维修断开点构成。先看实际车辆电气架构，再决定客户需要我们制作其中哪一部分。

title.en: Full cross-car loom or one defined branch?
title.zh: 整套横向线束，还是一条指定分支？

copy.en: A cross-car instrument-panel harness can bridge the left and right sides of a cockpit and break out to the cluster, center stack, HVAC, switch packs, junction block and body controller. Some projects need only a cluster-to-body jumper, a radio or display adapter, a console switch lead, or a service pigtail. The number of connectors is not the product definition: agree the cut points, ownership of adjacent modules, steering position, option content and allowable service disconnects first. The cockpit photograph shows application context, not a Super Smile finished harness.
copy.zh: 横跨仪表台的总线束可能从驾驶侧延伸至副驾侧，向组合仪表、中控、空调、开关组、配电盒和车身控制器分支。有的项目只需要仪表盘到车身的跳线、主机或显示转接线、中控开关引线，或维修短尾线。接头数量不能代替产品定义：先明确断开点、相邻模块归属、左右舵、选装配置和可维修断开位置。座舱照片只说明应用场景，不是超斯迈尔成品线束。

copy.en: Mark every controller-side and device-side interface in the drawing.
copy.zh: 在图纸中标出每个控制器侧和器件侧接口。

copy.en: Trim and steering layout can change branch count and reach.
copy.zh: 配置与方向盘位置会改变分支数和可达长度。

title.en: Power and data at the instrument cluster
title.zh: 组合仪表的电源与数据信号

copy.en: A modern cluster may receive ignition or battery feeds, grounds, illumination control and vehicle information through CAN, LIN or another platform-specific link. Older architectures can also have direct sensor or lamp circuits. Therefore a connector with the right cavity count is not enough: the drawing must identify cavity view, power domains, bus pair or single-wire route, shield or termination requirements where specified, and the corresponding cluster and body-controller versions. Displayed warnings and gauges depend on software and vehicle configuration as well as wiring. The illuminated cluster photo is a visual endpoint, not proof of a particular electrical system.
copy.zh: 现代组合仪表可能获得点火或常电供电、接地、照明控制，并通过 CAN、LIN 或平台指定的其他链路接收车辆信息；较早架构也可能保留直接传感器或指示灯回路。因此，孔数相同远远不够：图纸应确认孔位视图、供电域、总线线对或单线走向、规定的屏蔽或终端要求，以及对应的仪表与车身控制器版本。警告与仪表读数还受软件和车辆配置影响，不能仅靠线束导通保证。夜间仪表照片展示可见端点，不代表某一固定电气架构。

copy.en: CAN, LIN and direct circuits are platform choices, not universal pins.
copy.zh: CAN、LIN 与直接回路是平台选择，不是通用针位。

copy.en: A cluster replacement may also require controller and configuration review.
copy.zh: 替换仪表时，还可能需要核对控制器与配置。

title.en: Small control branches still need a circuit identity
title.zh: 小开关分支也要有明确回路身份

copy.en: Hazard, defogger, steering-column, HVAC and accessory controls can sit only centimeters apart while using different supply, ground, illumination and communication schemes. Switch appearance does not tell whether it carries a direct load, a low-current input to the body controller, or a local LIN command. An adapter or replacement pigtail needs the exact switch assembly reference, pin orientation, mating connector and permitted load. Route branches so the center stack can be removed without pulling on terminals; leave defined service slack without creating a snag point. The pictured rear-window control illustrates a dashboard switch location only.
copy.zh: 危险警示、除雾、转向柱、空调及附件控制器件可能只相隔几厘米，却采用不同的供电、接地、照明和通信方式。开关外观不能判断它承载的是直接负载、送往车身控制器的小电流输入，还是局部 LIN 指令。转接或维修尾线需要准确的开关总成资料、针脚方向、对插件与允许负载。分支走线既要让中控可拆卸，又不能拉扯端子；维修余量要明确，不能形成勾挂点。图中后窗控制仅说明仪表台开关位置。

copy.en: A common-looking button can be an input, not a power switch.
copy.zh: 看起来普通的按钮可能是信号输入，而非功率开关。

copy.en: Set connector reach and slack against the actual trim-removal path.
copy.zh: 依据实际拆卸路径确定接头可达性与余量。

title.en: Center-stack connections are more than audio power
title.zh: 中控连接不只是音响供电

copy.en: A head unit, center display or telematics module may require separately defined power, ground, speaker, microphone, USB, antenna, camera or vehicle-data interfaces. These functions are not interchangeable simply because two housings look alike. An ISO-style head-unit connector may be relevant to some vehicles, while other platforms use different multiway or high-speed interfaces. Specify the exact module, pin table, signal direction and shielding or pair treatment for each project. The photographed center stack is an interface context; it does not imply that this particular vehicle uses every circuit listed here.
copy.zh: 车机、中控屏或通信模块可能分别需要电源、接地、扬声器、麦克风、USB、天线、摄像头或车载数据接口。这些功能不能因为接头外形相似就互换。某些车型可采用 ISO 类主机接口，其他平台则使用不同的多针或高速接口。每个项目都应写清准确模块、针脚表、信号方向以及规定的屏蔽或线对处理。照片中的中控仅是接口场景，不表示这辆车同时具有文中所有回路。

copy.en: Audio, camera, USB and vehicle data need their own electrical definitions.
copy.zh: 音频、摄像头、USB 与车载数据各需独立电气定义。

copy.en: Confirm the mating part and pinout before an adapter is released.
copy.zh: 转接件放行前核实对插料号与针脚定义。

title.en: The dashboard meets the rest of the vehicle here
title.zh: 仪表台在这里接入整车

copy.en: Instrument-panel wiring typically meets body, door, steering-column and power-distribution circuits at defined junctions. Body-controller inputs and outputs may be multiplexed rather than carried as one wire per function. The harness must preserve the approved connector key, cavity, terminal and secondary-lock combination; an apparently spare cavity may be reserved or differently populated on another trim. Plan access to junction blocks, fuses and service disconnects before fixing branch length. The photographed in-car multiway plugs illustrate connector density, not a universal pin map or approved repair method.
copy.zh: 仪表台布线通常在指定汇接位置与车身、车门、转向柱和配电回路连接。车身控制器输入输出可能采用复用通信，而不是每个功能各走一根线。线束必须遵守批准的连接器防错、孔位、端子与二次锁组合；表面空闲的孔位，在另一配置下可能已有用途。确定分支长度前先考虑配电盒、保险丝与维修断开点的可达性。车内多针插头照片仅说明接口密度，不提供通用针脚表或批准的维修方法。

copy.en: Connector color and shape alone cannot identify a body circuit.
copy.zh: 颜色和外形本身不能识别车身回路。

copy.en: Do not bury a disconnect behind an inaccessible carrier or duct.
copy.zh: 不要把断开点埋入无法触及的骨架或风道后。

title.en: Design around the carrier, ducts and safety systems
title.zh: 围绕骨架、风道与安全系统布线

copy.en: The installed route passes cross-car beams, steering support, HVAC ducts, glovebox edges and trim fasteners. Define branch datums, clip and tie positions, anti-rattle protection, bend relief and clearances to sharp or moving parts. Cabin heat and material requirements come from the vehicle specification; a neat-looking wrap is not evidence of approved flammability or abrasion performance. Airbag and other SRS circuits are safety critical. Do not splice, extend or reproduce them from a photo or sample alone; any inclusion requires OEM drawings, traceability and a separately controlled validation plan. The open center-stack photo illustrates packaging and service access, not an SRS assembly.
copy.zh: 实际走线要经过横梁、转向支架、空调风道、手套箱边缘及内饰紧固点。需定义分支基准、卡扣与扎带位置、防异响保护、弯曲缓解，以及与锐边或运动件的间隙。车内耐热和材料要求来自车型规范；包扎整齐并不证明阻燃或耐磨性能已获批准。安全气囊等 SRS 回路属于安全关键部件，不能只凭照片或旧样拼接、延长或仿制；如项目涉及，必须具备整车方图纸、追溯和单独受控验证计划。拆开的中控照片仅说明布置与维修空间，不是 SRS 组件。

copy.en: Account for trim removal, not only installed-state reach.
copy.zh: 不仅考虑装车可达，还要考虑拆卸内饰的路径。

copy.en: Continuity inspection is never a crash-safety qualification.
copy.zh: 导通检查绝不等于碰撞安全验证。

title.en: Turn an interface list into a repeatable build
title.zh: 把接口清单变成可重复制作的线束

copy.en: For a new assembly or a replacement based on an old sample, reconcile connector part numbers, face and wire-side views, cavity numbers, wire sections, splice stations and branch dimensions before cutting material. Choose conductor, insulation, terminal and protection only after loads, data paths, installation temperature and required vehicle specifications are known. The first article should be checked for mating, terminal seating, lock position, clip location, clearance, labels and the approved circuit matrix. Continuity and short checks verify wiring identity; powered HMI operation, EMC, durability or vehicle safety need separately specified test methods and acceptance limits. The photo shows head-unit plug geometry as a reference, not a part we claim to supply.
copy.zh: 新项目或按旧样制作替换件，都要在下料前核对接头料号、正面与线侧视图、孔位号、线径、拼接站位和分支尺寸。负载、数据路径、安装温度及车型规范确定后，才选择导体、绝缘、端子与防护。首件应检查对插、端子入位、锁止位置、卡扣、间隙、标签和批准的回路矩阵。导通与短路检查用于验证布线身份；上电人机界面、EMC、耐久或整车安全需另行规定试验方法与验收限值。照片仅作主机插头几何参考，不代表我们供应图中具体零件。

copy.en: Face and wire-side views can reverse a cavity interpretation.
copy.zh: 正面和线侧视图可能导致孔位理解相反。

copy.en: No unperformed vehicle-function claim follows from a continuity pass.
copy.zh: 导通合格不能推导未执行的整车功能结论。

q.en: Is a cluster pigtail the same as a complete dashboard harness?
q.zh: 仪表盘短引线等同于整套仪表台线束吗？

a.en: No. A pigtail covers a defined cluster interface; a cross-car harness can include switches, HVAC, displays, junctions and body-controller branches. Specify the exact breakpoints and vehicle variant.
a.zh: 不等同。短引线只覆盖指定仪表接口；横向总线束可能包含开关、空调、显示、配电与车身控制器分支。应明确断开点及车型变型。

q.en: Can matching cluster plugs be interchanged?
q.zh: 仪表插头能对插，就可以互换吗？

a.en: No. Confirm cavity view, pin map, power domains, network protocol, cluster and controller references, and software configuration. Plug fit alone does not prove displayed information or warning behavior.
a.zh: 不能。还需确认孔位视图、针脚表、供电域、网络协议、仪表与控制器料号以及软件配置。能插上不能证明显示或警示行为正确。

q.en: Can you reproduce an airbag or SRS branch from an old sample?
q.zh: 可以按旧样复制安全气囊或 SRS 分支吗？

a.en: Not from a sample alone. SRS circuits are safety critical and require OEM-approved drawings, component traceability, controlled process and separately defined validation. We would first review whether that scope is appropriate for the project.
a.zh: 不能只凭旧样。SRS 回路属于安全关键部件，需要整车方批准图纸、元件追溯、受控工艺和单独验证。我们会先审核项目范围是否适合承接。

q.en: What changes between left- and right-hand-drive layouts?
q.zh: 左舵和右舵会改变哪些内容？

a.en: Cluster and steering-column positions, cross-car branch lengths, clip locations, service access and some option connections may change. They should be treated as controlled variants, not assumed mirror images.
a.zh: 仪表和转向柱位置、横向分支长度、卡扣位置、维修可达性及部分选装接口都可能改变，应作为受控变型处理，不能简单镜像。

q.en: What information should accompany a quotation request?
q.zh: 询价时应提供哪些资料？

a.en: Please provide the vehicle platform and year, trim and steering layout, cluster and controller references, connector and cavity views, circuit table, route or sample, branch datums, material requirements, quantity and requested inspections.
a.zh: 请提供车型平台与年款、配置和左右舵、仪表及控制器资料、连接器与孔位视图、回路表、走线图或样品、分支基准、材料要求、数量和所需检验。
